findings.summary: toggleCheckboxAt still returns `true` on paths where setData silently writes nothing (spill ghost cells, pivot sheets)
findings.evidence: The new guard only covers `cell?.f` (sheet.ts:3842). `setData` bails early for other read-only cases: `if (this.pivotDefinition) return;` (sheet.ts:995) and `if (existing?.spillAnchor) return;` (sheet.ts:1004 — a spill ghost cell has `v` but no `f`, so it passes the new guard). In those cases `toggleCheckboxAt` still returns `true` (sheet.ts:3847), so `Spreadsheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (spreadsheet.ts:365-367) and the Space handler (worksheet.ts:4853) report/act as if a toggle happened while the stored value is unchanged. The same 'checkbox over a computed cell is read-only' intent that motivated the `f` guard applies to a spill ghost cell, whose value is likewise formula-driven.

findings.summary: Case-fold gate uses strict `=== undefined` while checkedValueOf/uncheckedValueOf use `??`, so `null` (or `''`) custom values behave inconsistently
findings.evidence: `if (rule.checkedValue === undefined && rule.uncheckedValue === undefined)` (line 163) vs `rule.checkedValue ?? CHECKBOX_TRUE` (line 140). A rule that round-trips through JSON/Yorkie or an importer with `checkedValue: null` takes the exact-match branch even though `checkedValueOf` still resolves to the default `'TRUE'` — silently disabling the new case-insensitive behavior for a rule that is in every other respect a default checkbox. With `checkedValue: ''` it is worse: exact-match against `''`, so a `TRUE` cell renders unchecked and toggling writes `''`. No producer of these fields exists in-repo today, so this is latent rather than currently reachable.

findings.summary: Space over a formula-backed checkbox is now silently swallowed (preventDefault with no action and no feedback)
findings.evidence: The Space handler matches on `getDataValidationAt(...)?.kind === 'checkbox'` (worksheet.ts:4844-4849), calls `event.preventDefault()` (4851) and then `toggleCheckboxAt`, which now returns false for formula cells. The keystroke is consumed but nothing happens and no render/notification occurs, so the user gets no indication that the control is read-only; previously the key at least had an effect (albeit the buggy overwrite). Same for the click path (worksheet.ts:3405), which ignores the return value entirely.

findings.summary: Read-then-write in toggleCheckboxAt is not atomic; two rapid toggles can interleave and lose one flip
findings.evidence: `const cell = await this.getCell(ref);` (3839) then `await this.setData(ref, next);` (3846) with no lock/batch spanning both. Two clicks or Space presses issued before the first `setData` resolves both read the same `cell?.v` and both compute the same `next`, so the second toggle is lost. Pre-existing, but the function is being modified here and the new early return does not address it.

findings.summary: Formula-guard test's "writes no literal" claim is not asserted (cell.v never checked)
findings.evidence: packages/sheets/test/sheet/data-validation.test.ts:66-69 comments "reports false, keeps the formula, writes no literal" but only asserts `cell?.f === '=1=1'`. It never asserts `cell?.v` is still the formula's computed value ('TRUE') rather than an overwritten literal. The core behavior (return false + formula preserved) IS genuinely covered — without the `cell?.f` guard in sheet.ts:3840 `setData` would clear `f` — so this is a narrowness gap, not a vacuous test. Adding `expect(cell?.v).toBe('TRUE')` would make the stated claim actually checked.

The genuinely new behavior is covered by lines 99-104 and 126-127, so this is a nit-to-minor precision point, not fake coverage of the change.

findings.summary: No test exercises the click/Space view paths that reach the new formula guard
findings.evidence: worksheet.ts:3405 and 4853 call `sheet.toggleCheckboxAt`, and gridcanvas.ts:1042 calls `isCheckboxChecked(rule, cell?.v)`. Both changed behaviors are only tested at model/Sheet level; no view-layer or browser-lane test asserts a formula-backed checkbox is unclickable or that a lowercase `true` renders checked. Since the guard sits in Sheet and all view paths route through it, this is acceptable coverage, but the render path (gridcanvas) case-insensitivity has no test at all. Searched packages/sheets/test and src for gridcanvas/worksheet checkbox tests via grep for toggleCheckboxAt/isCheckboxChecked — only the two files above.

findings.summary: Hand-rolled case-insensitive TRUE/FALSE recognition instead of reusing the existing boolean recognizer the design doc points at
findings.evidence: The design doc's checkbox value-storage section (docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md:106-110) states checkbox values "Reuse the existing boolean round-trip: formula engine BoolNode ... and input recognition (input.ts:242-247)". `inferInput` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/input.ts:241-247) already lower-cases and matches 'true'/'false'; the diff adds a third, independent case-fold (`value.toUpperCase() === CHECKBOX_TRUE`) in data-validation.ts rather than a shared predicate (e.g. an exported `isBooleanLiteral`/reuse of `inferInput`). Not a blocker, but it is the kind of duplication this repo asks to avoid, and the three sites can now drift.

findings.summary: Fix applied at the compare/render layer rather than at ingestion, leaving other consumers of the raw value inconsistent
findings.evidence: The stated cause is that xlsx import / REST API / external paste bypass `setData` normalization. Case-folding only inside `isCheckboxChecked` means the glyph renders checked while everything else that reads the raw `v` (formula comparisons/COUNTIF against 'TRUE', boolean auto-centering at input.ts:351 which is exact-match on 'TRUE'/'FALSE', sorting) still sees the lowercase string. Normalizing at the ingestion boundary would keep the whole stack consistent. The originating task (docs/tasks/active/20260712-checkbox-validation-bugfix-todo.md:18-26) does prescribe the render/toggle-path fix, so this is an approach preference, not an unmet criterion.

findings.summary: Design-scope widened vs the task's literal criterion (both custom values absent, not just checkedValue)
findings.evidence: The task says "Fix scope: default boolean checkbox only (no custom checkedValue)" (docs/tasks/active/20260712-checkbox-validation-bugfix-todo.md:25). The implementation gates on both `checkedValue === undefined && uncheckedValue === undefined`. This is a deliberate, documented tightening (task Review [0], and the design-doc text), and it is the safer semantics — flagging only so the deviation from the written criterion is on record.

findings.summary: Fixed behavior documented inside the 'known simplifications / follow-ups' list rather than in the checkbox behavior section
findings.evidence: Lines 249-252 introduce the list as "simplifications, each a small follow-up to close"; the new bullet now describes *shipped, correct* behavior ('fixed as a follow-up'). The canonical home for the formula read-only rule is line 115-116 ('A cell over a formula with a checkbox rule is read-only'), and the case-insensitivity belongs near the value-storage section (106-110). Leaving it in the limitations list makes the doc read as if these are still gaps. The bullet also records micro-implementation detail ('compare without allocating on the per-repaint path') that is code-comment material, not design.

findings.summary: Task doc has two '## Review' sections, the second an unfilled placeholder, and stays under docs/tasks/active with every box checked
findings.evidence: Line 40 has a filled '## Review' and line 67 repeats '## Review' with '(filled after implementation)'. All plan checkboxes (lines 30-38) are `[x]`, yet the file lives in docs/tasks/active/ while completed peers live under docs/tasks/archive/2026/07/. Doc hygiene only.

findings.summary: New `value.toUpperCase()` fallback runs on unbounded, attacker-supplied cell text on the per-repaint render path (client-side memory-churn DoS)
findings.evidence: Vector: a collaborator (Yorkie doc), an xlsx import, or the REST API writes a very large string (no cell-length cap exists — grepped packages/sheets/src and the repo for MaxCell/maxLength/slice(0,N) limits and found none) into cells covered by a checkbox rule. `GridCanvas.renderCellCheckbox` (packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1042) calls `isCheckboxChecked(rule, cell?.v)` for every visible checkbox cell on every repaint. Before this change the function did only `value === checkedValueOf(rule)`, which is O(1) for mismatched lengths and allocates nothing. Now, any value that is neither the canonical `TRUE` nor `FALSE` falls through to `value.toUpperCase()` (line 166), allocating a full uppercased copy of the cell text per visible checkbox cell per frame — during scrolling that is tens-to-hundreds of large allocations per second in other users' browsers, i.e. an amplification of untrusted input into GC pressure. Cheap hardening: bail early when `value.length !== CHECKBOX_TRUE.length` (or compare the four chars in place) before allocating. Impact is a browser-tab slowdown/OOM, not data compromise, hence minor; I did not build a working PoC, hence medium confidence.

findings.summary: Case-folded checkbox rendering can make displayed state diverge from the stored literal (UI state spoofing for approval-style checkboxes)
findings.evidence: After this change a cell holding `"tRue"` (writable by any collaborator, xlsx import, or REST caller without going through `setData` normalization — the diff's own comment states such values bypass normalization) renders as a filled/checked box in `renderCellCheckbox` (packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1042), while the stored value is not the canonical `TRUE` that exact-match consumers (export, downstream `=A1="TRUE"` style comparisons, any backend reader) compare against. Where a checkbox encodes an approval/consent decision, a viewer can be shown "checked" while the persisted literal is a non-canonical string, i.e. the rendered state is not authoritative. I could not identify a consumer in this repo that makes a security decision on the raw value (grep for `isCheckboxChecked` finds only gridcanvas.ts and tests), so this stays low confidence and minor; noted because the change widens what renders as "checked" based on untrusted input.

findings.summary: Widened checkbox matching now disagrees with the formula engine for mixed-case booleans: a cell holding `True` renders CHECKED (isCheckboxChecked case-folds) but `Evaluator.resolveValue` only coerces the exact strings `'TRUE'`/`'true'` to a boolean, so formulas referencing that cell see a plain string. A checked box and `=IF(A1,...)`/`=COUNTIF(range,TRUE)` therefore report opposite states for the same cell.
findings.evidence: packages/sheets/src/formula/formula.ts:1054 `if (val === 'TRUE' || val === 'true') return { t: 'bool', v: true };` — no case-folding for `True`. Same exact-pair check at packages/sheets/src/formula/functions-operator.ts:18 and packages/sheets/src/formula/arguments.ts:179, and formula.ts:761. Meanwhile packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/data-validation.ts:166 accepts any casing. Fix belongs either on the new case-fold (restrict to the casings the engine accepts) or by case-folding in resolveValue.

findings.summary: The new doc comment (and the design doc) justify the change by asserting the formula engine already treats TRUE/FALSE case-insensitively; it does not — it accepts only the two exact spellings `TRUE`/`true`. The comment describes a contract other modules do not implement, which will mislead the next reader/maintainer of this helper.
findings.evidence: Claim at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/data-validation.ts:150-151 ("the formula engine and input parser already treat TRUE/FALSE case-insensitively") vs packages/sheets/src/formula/formula.ts:1054-1055 (exact `'TRUE'|'true'`). Only the input parser (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/input.ts:241-247, `trimmed.toLowerCase()`) is truly case-insensitive. Same wording is repeated in docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md:255-257.

findings.summary: Presentation consumers of raw boolean values were not widened alongside isCheckboxChecked: `defaultAlign` centers only the exact `TRUE`/`FALSE` strings, so a lowercase/mixed-case value that now renders as a checked checkbox is still classified as plain left-aligned text everywhere the checkbox glyph is not drawn (e.g. after `removeCheckbox`, which deliberately leaves the value behind).
findings.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/input.ts:351 `if (rawValue === 'TRUE' || rawValue === 'FALSE') return 'center';` — a `true` value that the new isCheckboxChecked treats as boolean-checked is not treated as a boolean here. Sheet.removeCheckbox (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:3818) leaves such values in the grid.

findings.summary: The formula guard makes both view entry points silently swallow the interaction: the Space handler calls `event.preventDefault()` before `toggleCheckboxAt` and only re-renders on `true`, and the click handler calls `preventDefault()`/`return` regardless of the result. Over a formula-backed checkbox the user now gets no toggle and no feedback, and the keystroke/click is consumed rather than falling through to normal editing/selection.
findings.evidence: packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4850-4856 (`event.preventDefault();` then `if (await this.sheet!.toggleCheckboxAt(ref))`) and packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:3402-3407 (`e.preventDefault(); ... await this.sheet!.toggleCheckboxAt(ref); this.render(); return;`) — neither distinguishes "no rule" from the new "formula cell, read-only" false.

findings.summary: The new case-fold gate tests `checkedValue === undefined && uncheckedValue === undefined` with strict equality, while `checkedValueOf`/`uncheckedValueOf` normalize with `??`. A rule that round-trips through JSON/Yorkie or an external REST payload carrying `checkedValue: null` (or `''`) is treated as "has custom values" by the gate but as default by the accessors, so the case-insensitive branch silently switches off (with `''` it also matches nothing). Would need to confirm whether the Yorkie/REST layer can persist null/empty here.
findings.evidence: Gate: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/data-validation.ts:163 (`=== undefined`) vs accessors at :140/:143 (`?? CHECKBOX_TRUE`). Rules are persisted verbatim through packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:892-921 (`cloneDataValidationRule`), which does not strip null fields, and the fields are optional in packages/sheets/src/model/core/types.ts:170-171.

diff --git a/docs/tasks/active/20260712-checkbox-validation-bugfix-todo.md b/docs/tasks/active/20260712-checkbox-validation-bugfix-todo.md

@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+# Checkbox data-validation bug fixes
+
+Follow-ups from the data-validation design doc (`docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md`,
+Phase-1 "Not yet guarded" note). Two clear correctness bugs in the shipped
+checkbox control, each self-contained.
+
+## Bugs
+
+1. **Formula cell is not read-only under a checkbox rule.**
+   `Sheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (`sheet.ts:3834`) reads `cell?.v` and writes a
+   literal `TRUE`/`FALSE` via `setData` without checking `cell.f`. Toggling a
+   checkbox that sits over a formula cell **overwrites the formula**. Design
+   intent: a formula-backed checkbox is read-only (the formula drives the
+   state) — Google Sheets / Excel parity. Both the click path
+   (`worksheet.ts:3405`) and the Space path (`worksheet.ts:4853`) route through
+   `toggleCheckboxAt`, so one guard fixes both.
+
+2. **`isCheckboxChecked` is case-sensitive.**
+   `isCheckboxChecked` (`data-validation.ts:149`) compares `value === 'TRUE'`
+   exactly, so a cell holding `"true"` renders **unchecked**. `setData`
+   normalizes typed input to `"TRUE"`, but values arriving via xlsx import /
+   REST API / external paste can be lowercase and bypass normalization. The
+   formula engine (`formula.ts:1054`) and input parser (`input.ts:242`) already
+   treat `TRUE`/`FALSE` case-insensitively; the render/toggle path should match.
+   Fix scope: **default boolean checkbox only** (no custom `checkedValue`) —
+   a custom checked value stays an exact string match (GS parity).
+
+## Plan (TDD)
+
+- [x] Model test: `isCheckboxChecked` matches `"true"`/`"True"`/`"TRUE"` for a
+      default rule; a custom-value rule stays exact-match.
+- [x] Model fix: `isCheckboxChecked` case-insensitive for the fully-default
+      boolean checkbox only; `toggleCheckboxValue` inherits the fix (delegates).
+- [x] Sheet test: `toggleCheckboxAt` over a formula cell is a no-op — returns
+      `false`, leaves `cell.f` intact, writes no `v`.
+- [x] Sheet fix: guard `toggleCheckboxAt` on `cell?.f`.
+- [x] `pnpm test` (sheets) green; `pnpm verify:fast` green (EXIT 0).
+- [x] Update design doc Phase-1 "Not yet guarded" note (both now fixed).
+
+## Review
+
+High-effort workflow code review (`Workflow code-review`, 4 finders + verify)
+surfaced two findings, both addressed:
+
+- **[0] correctness (PLAUSIBLE)** — case-fold branch was gated only on
+  `checkedValue === undefined`, so a rule with a custom `uncheckedValue` that
+  upper-cases to `"TRUE"` inverted state. Fixed: case-folding now requires
+  *both* custom values absent; added a regression test.
+- **[1] cleanup (CONFIRMED)** — `value.toUpperCase()` allocated per repaint,
+  against the file's no-alloc convention. Fixed: canonical `TRUE`/`FALSE`
+  short-circuit before the `toUpperCase` fallback.
+
+A refuted finding ("silently depends on `CHECKBOX_TRUE` being uppercase") was
+dismissed by the verifier — `CHECKBOX_TRUE` is a module constant.
+
+Both bugs are model/Sheet-level; the click and Space view paths route through
+`toggleCheckboxAt` and the render path through `isCheckboxChecked`, so no
+view-layer change was needed. View-layer smoke deferred (Phase-1 precedent).
+
+## Out of scope (separate follow-ups)
+
+- Space range-uniform "set all checked" (parity feature, not a bug).
+- Merged-cell glyph/hit-test mismatch.
+- Eager `FALSE` materialization for `COUNTIF`.
+- Custom checkbox values UI.
+
+## Review
+
+(filled after implementation)

+# Checkbox data-validation bug fixes
+
+Follow-ups from the data-validation design doc (`docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md`,
+Phase-1 "Not yet guarded" note). Two clear correctness bugs in the shipped
+checkbox control, each self-contained.
+
+## Bugs
+
+1. **Formula cell is not read-only under a checkbox rule.**
+   `Sheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (`sheet.ts:3834`) reads `cell?.v` and writes a
+   literal `TRUE`/`FALSE` via `setData` without checking `cell.f`. Toggling a
+   checkbox that sits over a formula cell **overwrites the formula**. Design
+   intent: a formula-backed checkbox is read-only (the formula drives the
+   state) — Google Sheets / Excel parity. Both the click path
+   (`worksheet.ts:3405`) and the Space path (`worksheet.ts:4853`) route through
+   `toggleCheckboxAt`, so one guard fixes both.
+
+2. **`isCheckboxChecked` is case-sensitive.**
+   `isCheckboxChecked` (`data-validation.ts:149`) compares `value === 'TRUE'`
+   exactly, so a cell holding `"true"` renders **unchecked**. `setData`
+   normalizes typed input to `"TRUE"`, but values arriving via xlsx import /
+   REST API / external paste can be lowercase and bypass normalization. The
+   formula engine (`formula.ts:1054`) and input parser (`input.ts:242`) already
+   treat `TRUE`/`FALSE` case-insensitively; the render/toggle path should match.
+   Fix scope: **default boolean checkbox only** (no custom `checkedValue`) —
+   a custom checked value stays an exact string match (GS parity).
+
+## Plan (TDD)
+
+- [x] Model test: `isCheckboxChecked` matches `"true"`/`"True"`/`"TRUE"` for a
+      default rule; a custom-value rule stays exact-match.
+- [x] Model fix: `isCheckboxChecked` case-insensitive for the fully-default
+      boolean checkbox only; `toggleCheckboxValue` inherits the fix (delegates).
+- [x] Sheet test: `toggleCheckboxAt` over a formula cell is a no-op — returns
+      `false`, leaves `cell.f` intact, writes no `v`.
+- [x] Sheet fix: guard `toggleCheckboxAt` on `cell?.f`.
+- [x] `pnpm test` (sheets) green; `pnpm verify:fast` green (EXIT 0).
+- [x] Update design doc Phase-1 "Not yet guarded" note (both now fixed).
+
+## Review
+
+High-effort workflow code review (`Workflow code-review`, 4 finders + verify)
+surfaced two findings, both addressed:
+
+- **[0] correctness (PLAUSIBLE)** — case-fold branch was gated only on
+  `checkedValue === undefined`, so a rule with a custom `uncheckedValue` that
+  upper-cases to `"TRUE"` inverted state. Fixed: case-folding now requires
+  *both* custom values absent; added a regression test.
+- **[1] cleanup (CONFIRMED)** — `value.toUpperCase()` allocated per repaint,
+  against the file's no-alloc convention. Fixed: canonical `TRUE`/`FALSE`
+  short-circuit before the `toUpperCase` fallback.
+
+A refuted finding ("silently depends on `CHECKBOX_TRUE` being uppercase") was
+dismissed by the verifier — `CHECKBOX_TRUE` is a module constant.
+
+Both bugs are model/Sheet-level; the click and Space view paths route through
+`toggleCheckboxAt` and the render path through `isCheckboxChecked`, so no
+view-layer change was needed. View-layer smoke deferred (Phase-1 precedent).
+
+## Out of scope (separate follow-ups)
+
+- Space range-uniform "set all checked" (parity feature, not a bug).
+- Merged-cell glyph/hit-test mismatch.
+- Eager `FALSE` materialization for `COUNTIF`.
+- Custom checkbox values UI.
+
+## Review
+
+(filled after implementation)

samples.summary: New `value.toUpperCase()` fallback runs on unbounded, attacker-supplied cell text on the per-repaint render path (client-side memory-churn DoS)
samples.evidence: Vector: a collaborator (Yorkie doc), an xlsx import, or the REST API writes a very large string (no cell-length cap exists — grepped packages/sheets/src and the repo for MaxCell/maxLength/slice(0,N) limits and found none) into cells covered by a checkbox rule. `GridCanvas.renderCellCheckbox` (packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1042) calls `isCheckboxChecked(rule, cell?.v)` for every visible checkbox cell on every repaint. Before this change the function did only `value === checkedValueOf(rule)`, which is O(1) for mismatched lengths and allocates nothing. Now, any value that is neither the canonical `TRUE` nor `FALSE` falls through to `value.toUpperCase()` (line 166), allocating a full uppercased copy of the cell text per visible checkbox cell per frame — during scrolling that is tens-to-hundreds of large allocations per second in other users' browsers, i.e. an amplification of untrusted input into GC pressure. Cheap hardening: bail early when `value.length !== CHECKBOX_TRUE.length` (or compare the four chars in place) before allocating. Impact is a browser-tab slowdown/OOM, not data compromise, hence minor; I did not build a working PoC, hence medium confidence.

samples.summary: Case-folded checkbox rendering can make displayed state diverge from the stored literal (UI state spoofing for approval-style checkboxes)
samples.evidence: After this change a cell holding `"tRue"` (writable by any collaborator, xlsx import, or REST caller without going through `setData` normalization — the diff's own comment states such values bypass normalization) renders as a filled/checked box in `renderCellCheckbox` (packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1042), while the stored value is not the canonical `TRUE` that exact-match consumers (export, downstream `=A1="TRUE"` style comparisons, any backend reader) compare against. Where a checkbox encodes an approval/consent decision, a viewer can be shown "checked" while the persisted literal is a non-canonical string, i.e. the rendered state is not authoritative. I could not identify a consumer in this repo that makes a security decision on the raw value (grep for `isCheckboxChecked` finds only gridcanvas.ts and tests), so this stays low confidence and minor; noted because the change widens what renders as "checked" based on untrusted input.

samples.summary: Widened checkbox matching now disagrees with the formula engine for mixed-case booleans: a cell holding `True` renders CHECKED (isCheckboxChecked case-folds) but `Evaluator.resolveValue` only coerces the exact strings `'TRUE'`/`'true'` to a boolean, so formulas referencing that cell see a plain string. A checked box and `=IF(A1,...)`/`=COUNTIF(range,TRUE)` therefore report opposite states for the same cell.
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/formula/formula.ts:1054 `if (val === 'TRUE' || val === 'true') return { t: 'bool', v: true };` — no case-folding for `True`. Same exact-pair check at packages/sheets/src/formula/functions-operator.ts:18 and packages/sheets/src/formula/arguments.ts:179, and formula.ts:761. Meanwhile packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/data-validation.ts:166 accepts any casing. Fix belongs either on the new case-fold (restrict to the casings the engine accepts) or by case-folding in resolveValue.

samples.summary: The new doc comment (and the design doc) justify the change by asserting the formula engine already treats TRUE/FALSE case-insensitively; it does not — it accepts only the two exact spellings `TRUE`/`true`. The comment describes a contract other modules do not implement, which will mislead the next reader/maintainer of this helper.
samples.evidence: Claim at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/data-validation.ts:150-151 ("the formula engine and input parser already treat TRUE/FALSE case-insensitively") vs packages/sheets/src/formula/formula.ts:1054-1055 (exact `'TRUE'|'true'`). Only the input parser (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/input.ts:241-247, `trimmed.toLowerCase()`) is truly case-insensitive. Same wording is repeated in docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md:255-257.

samples.summary: Presentation consumers of raw boolean values were not widened alongside isCheckboxChecked: `defaultAlign` centers only the exact `TRUE`/`FALSE` strings, so a lowercase/mixed-case value that now renders as a checked checkbox is still classified as plain left-aligned text everywhere the checkbox glyph is not drawn (e.g. after `removeCheckbox`, which deliberately leaves the value behind).
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/input.ts:351 `if (rawValue === 'TRUE' || rawValue === 'FALSE') return 'center';` — a `true` value that the new isCheckboxChecked treats as boolean-checked is not treated as a boolean here. Sheet.removeCheckbox (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:3818) leaves such values in the grid.

samples.summary: The formula guard makes both view entry points silently swallow the interaction: the Space handler calls `event.preventDefault()` before `toggleCheckboxAt` and only re-renders on `true`, and the click handler calls `preventDefault()`/`return` regardless of the result. Over a formula-backed checkbox the user now gets no toggle and no feedback, and the keystroke/click is consumed rather than falling through to normal editing/selection.
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4850-4856 (`event.preventDefault();` then `if (await this.sheet!.toggleCheckboxAt(ref))`) and packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:3402-3407 (`e.preventDefault(); ... await this.sheet!.toggleCheckboxAt(ref); this.render(); return;`) — neither distinguishes "no rule" from the new "formula cell, read-only" false.

samples.summary: The new case-fold gate tests `checkedValue === undefined && uncheckedValue === undefined` with strict equality, while `checkedValueOf`/`uncheckedValueOf` normalize with `??`. A rule that round-trips through JSON/Yorkie or an external REST payload carrying `checkedValue: null` (or `''`) is treated as "has custom values" by the gate but as default by the accessors, so the case-insensitive branch silently switches off (with `''` it also matches nothing). Would need to confirm whether the Yorkie/REST layer can persist null/empty here.

Rules are persisted verbatim through packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:892-921 (`cloneDataValidationRule`), which does not strip null fields, and the fields are optional in packages/sheets/src/model/core/types.ts:170-171.
